From the original press release.

http://www.thelasombra.com/bloodlines.txt

"Bloodlines will contain over 120 new cards, detailing the Ahrimanes,
Baali, Blood Brothers, Daughters of Cacophony, Gargoyles, Harbingers of
Skulls, Kiasyd, Nagaraja, Salubri, Samedi, and True Brujah along with
each faction's unique vampiric powers.
[...]
All new disciplines, major new deck strategies... better stay on Santa's
nice list!"

Beyond that, you're unlikely to get anything at all.

Going by past performance, however, there is likely to be a period with
"preview" cards.
